messages:
mira: Hey team — hitting a weird deserialization error in prod-dedicated for a small subset of requests. I need temporary access to raw request/response bodies for one trace to root cause. What scope/approvals do I need?

devon: Can you paste the trace id and why raw body is required vs masked samples? Also how long do you need access for?

mira: Trace id: trace-7b3f. Error happens during streaming fallback, seems related to certain multipart prompts. Masked samples haven't reproduced it. I want to capture the full request/response for one session for up to 24h. Will redact Authorization and cookie headers. Example of the capture config I was thinking:

```json
{
  "ephemeral_capture": true,
  "fields": ["headers", "body"],
  "mask_headers": ["authorization", "cookie"],
  "ttl_hours": 24
}
```

sam: Prefer not to keep full prompt text at all. If you must, store a tombstoned/hashed copy and the first 128 chars only. E.g. `prompt_hash = hmac_sha256(k, prompt)` so we can correlate without keeping PII. Also please scrub emails/phones before storing.

security-bot: Required process: 1) Create an internal ticket with justification and AOR (owner) 2) Security lead approval required for raw body access 3) Limit access to named engineers, timeboxed <= 72h, and ensure audit logging enabled 4) Mask auth tokens or replace with consistent token-id not raw secret 5) Prefer HMACed prompt vs plaintext. Ops playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/ephemeral-capture

devon: Who signs off as "security lead" for this? Also does the audit log show who viewed the capture?

security-bot: Security lead = @sam (for infra-apps) or @maria (for customer-data); audit log will record ticket id and user who downloaded the blob. Downloads require 2FA and are recorded to the audit index. No one should be able to decrypt an HMAC.

mira: Ok, I'll file the ticket now and HMAC the prompt. I'll also truncate to 128 chars and run a quick regex to redact emails/phones. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-12345 (just created). Requesting access for mira + devon for 24h.

devon: +1 to that scope, pls ensure header masking includes any custom client-secret headers. Also require deletion confirmation in the ticket when done.

sam: Quick note — embeddings and user identifiers should be pseudonymized (hash with per-env salt) not raw. If you embed parts of the prompt into any logs, ensure they do not contain PII.

ops-bot: Reminder: enable `ephemeral_capture` only on the single host or request id, not globally. Use `env=prod-dedicated` and `trace_id=trace-7b3f` filter.

mira: Thanks all. Will post the sanitized sample in the ticket and attach the audit id once download happens. Will follow deletion workflow after debug.

devon: Sounds good. Keep us posted, and ping if you need escalation to privacy. :thumbsup:

mira: Will do — thanks!
